defs.def: （与动词连用，表示朝某处或某位置运动）向，朝

ex.s: He pushed a chair onto the balcony, and climbed up   59   （see）them.
ex.t: 他把一把椅子推到阳台上，爬上去（第59空，see）他们。

ex.s: People in Thailand generally use their forks only to push food onto their spoons.
ex.t: 泰国人通常只用叉子把食物拨到勺子上。

ex.s: The boy lifted the last bag onto his shoulder, and flashed a bright smile.
ex.t: 男孩把最后一个袋子扛到肩上，露出了灿烂的笑容。

ex.s: They can be directed onto a specific area.
ex.t: 它们可以被导向特定区域。

ex.s: This forms clouds from which rain falls down onto the mountain terraces once again.
ex.t: 这形成了云层，雨水再次落在山台上。

ex.s: However, recent years have seen more and more unusual flavours come onto the market.
ex.t: 然而，近年来，市场上出现了越来越多不寻常的口味。

ex.s: Chinese characters are carved into small squares of stone and stamped onto paper with ink.
ex.t: 汉字被刻在小块方石上，再用墨拓印到纸上。

ex.s: In the 1980s, the team burst onto the international volleyball scene with several major world titles, and an amazing three-set victory over the United States in the final of the 1984 Los Angeles Olympics.
ex.t: 20世纪80年代，这支球队突然在国际排坛崭露头角，赢得了几个重要的世界冠军，并在1984年洛杉矶奥运会决赛中以惊人的三比零战胜美国。

ex.s: Alistair pushed himself towards the finish line in the burning heat, but as he came round the corner, he saw his brother about to fall onto the track.
ex.t: 阿利斯泰尔在燃烧的热量中将自己推向终点线，但当他来到拐角处时，他看见他的兄弟即将掉到赛道上。

defs.def: used to show that sth faces in a particular direction 朝向，面向（某个方向）

ex.s: These qualities, in turn, are mapped onto products that have been assigned a gender.
ex.t: 最有效的生活方式是努力成为那种罕见的混合体——狐狸式刺猍。

ex.s: in the future，the team hopes to develop a version of the technology that can be sprayed onto plant leaves in a one-off treatment that would last the plant’s lifetime.
ex.t: 未来，该团队希望开发一种技术版本，可以一次性喷洒到植物叶片上，效果持续植物一生。

ex.s: If you ever get the impression that your dog can "tell" whether you look content or annoyed, you may be onto something.
ex.t: 如果你得到的印象是 你的狗可以"说" 无论你看起来满足或烦恼，你可能会在的东西。

defs.def: to know about what sb has done wrong 发现（某人做了坏事）

ex.s: These include plants that have sensors printed onto their leaves to show when they’re short of water and a plant that can detect harmful chemicals in groundwater. ＂We’re thinking about how we can engineer plants to replace functions of the things that we use every day,＂explained Michael Strano, a professor of chemical engineering at MIT.
ex.t: 这些包括叶子上印有传感器、能显示植物何时缺水的植物，以及一种能检测地下水中有害化学物质的植物。“我们正在思考如何改造植物，以取代我们日常使用物品的功能，”麻省理工学院化学工程教授Michael Strano解释道。

defs.def: to be talking to sb, usually in order to ask or tell them sth 与 … 谈话；询问
